training_data: LCC-FASD train + 872 webcam crops at 1.4x (data/pad_webcam, splits/scale-1.4x, webcam rows oversampled x8 on a class-balanced sampler)
scope: Classroom demo on the recording webcam. Held-out webcam test (3 sessions): 0/52 phone-photo and 0/116 phone-video crops accepted, 96/96 live crops passed (previous model: 29/52, 67/116, 91/96). LCC-FASD test ACER 8.88% vs 5.72% for the previous model. One person, room and day; the same phone photo/video content appears in train and test sessions, and frames within a session are correlated.
